name: skill-audit
title: Skill Audit
description: Static and procedural audit toolkit for Agent Skills, including package integrity, instruction security, capabilities, attack chains, supply chain, routing, governance, SARIF and sandbox planning.
author: André Almeida

network_egress.reason: The host agent may retrieve a user-supplied public repository and check the canonical upstream version; the bundled static scanner itself performs no network requests.

subprocess.reason: The host may run the bundled scanner and tests as local subprocesses. The scanner never executes code from the audited target.

dependency_install.reason: The scanner and regression suite use only the Python standard library.
